name: IEA 15MW Monopile
subtitle: Fixed-bottom · Class IB · 15 MW
description: IEA 15-240-RWT reference turbine on a monopile substructure. Hub height 150 m, rotor diameter 240 m. Offshore fixed-bottom configuration from the IEA Wind Task 37 reference turbine series.
notes: ROSCO closed-loop control enabled (CompServo=1). libdiscon.dylib, IEA-15-240-RWT-Monopile_DISCON.IN, and Cp_Ct_Cq.IEA15MW.txt are bundled. The shared IEA-15-240-RWT/ sibling directory contains blade, airfoil, and Cp/Ct/Cq data referenced by relative path from the model.
